name: Simulon
summary: iPhone AR app that places AI neural assets in the real world and captures reactive photos/videos.
description: Simulon turns photos, sketches or text into neural assets you place in your surroundings via AR, then capture photoreal images or action videos that respond to the scene (Reality-Aware Rendering). Free tier: 100 one-time starter credits for library subjects. Plus $14.99/month for custom subjects; Pro $39.99/month for 3× usage and studio-tier video. iPhone now; Android coming soon.
features: Neural assets from photos, sketches or text
Action videos reacting to the scene
